evals.name: api-rate-limit
evals.prompt: Put a rate limit on the whole API so one client can't hammer us. We run behind Caddy on Uncloud.
evals.expected_output: httprate middleware on the API route group keyed on middleware.GetClientIP canonicalized, problem+json limit handler, in-memory counter, constant limit, router test with X-Forwarded-For.
assertions: Uses github.com/go-chi/httprate middleware on the API routes
Keys the limit on the client IP from middleware.GetClientIP (X-Forwarded-For), not RemoteAddr or httprate.KeyByIP
Sets WithLimitHandler so a 429 is answered as problem+json
Keeps httprate's in-memory counter (no Redis-backed WithLimitCounter)
Defines the limit as a constant next to the route group, not a new flag or config
A test sends limit+1 requests with one X-Forwarded-For and asserts 429, Retry-After and a problem+json body
A test shows a different client IP still gets 200

evals.name: cache-component
evals.prompt: Add a cache component handlers can use. Redis in production, nothing to install for local dev.
evals.expected_output: internal/cache with Cache interface and ErrMiss, memory (otter v2) and redis (go-redis v9) implementations from Open(ctx, url), --cache-url with APP_CACHE_URL, passed via web.Deps, closed on exit, shared cachetest suite, generic helpers.
assertions: Creates internal/cache with a Cache interface (ctx first) and an ErrMiss sentinel
Has an in-memory implementation built on github.com/maypok86/otter/v2
Has a Redis implementation built on github.com/redis/go-redis/v9
Chooses the implementation from a URL via Open(ctx, url) (memory:// and redis://)
serve gets a --cache-url flag with Sources cli.EnvVars("APP_CACHE_URL") and memory:// as default
The cache reaches handlers through web.Deps / handlers.API, not a package-level variable
The cache is closed when serve ends (defer Close)
One shared test suite (e.g. cachetest.Run) runs against the implementations; Redis is skipped without a URL env var
Typed helpers (GetAs/SetAs/GetOrSet) are generic package functions, not interface methods
